Hi Samantha —

Thanks for signing up and indicating interest in a private deployment for MedTrust Health. I’m Dylan on the SDR team. Would love to get a 30–45 minute deep-dive scheduled with one of our solutions engineers to cover VPC/on‑prem options, SOC 2 controls, and a high-level PoC checklist.

- Tue Aug 3, 1:00–1:45 PM ET
